chunks.content: Kelsey Conophy is a seasoned technical AI product leader, entrepreneur, and startup advisor based in Bozeman, MT. She is open to speaking engagements, advisor appointments, and fractional CPO roles. She builds AI products and leads teams that build AI products. She has 13+ years of experience creating and scaling AI systems across GitHub, Amazon, Intuit, and multiple startups.

Kelsey is an AI product leader, entrepreneur, and builder with 13+ years of experience creating and scaling AI systems that operate at global scale. Her expertise spans AI agents, LLMs (Large Language Models), deep learning, reinforcement learning, and machine learning systems. She has led R&D, AI platform, and applied-AI teams across GitHub, Amazon, Intuit and multiple hyper-growth startups.

Kelsey has led R&D, AI platform, and applied-AI teams across GitHub, Amazon, Intuit and multiple hyper-growth startups including Attentive, Rent the Runway, and Birchbox. She has delivered industry-defining products and next-generation AI capabilities in production. She has 7+ years of experience building and leading high-impact teams of 60+ people.

Kelsey has 7+ years of experience building and leading high-impact teams of 60+ people with cultures rooted in experimentation, data, and customer obsession. She thrives at the intersection of R&D and applied AI product, turning emerging AI research into scalable, production products that deliver impact. She is most energized by 0-1 invention and scaling 1-n products that push boundaries of what's possible with AI.

Kelsey is most energized by 0-1 invention and scaling 1-n products that push boundaries of what's possible with AI. She excels at turning emerging AI research into scalable, production products. She thrives at the intersection of R&D and applied AI product, delivering industry-defining products.
In her spare time Kelsey enjoys skiing the backcountry and climbing the limestone faces in beautiful southwest Montana. She is based in Bozeman, MT.

Intuit Assist for Help Interactions is Intuit's Generative AI assistant that helps customers and experts get support and complete tasks more efficiently and easily. Technologies used include Intuit's Foundation LLM FILM, and public and open source LLMs including GPT 3.5 & 4, Gemini, Claude 3 Opus & Haiku, and Mistral Large.
Sticky Notes is a simple meeting notes app for anyone that Kelsey built.
Catalyst SPORT App is a workout tracking app for personal trainers and their clients that Kelsey built.
Catalyst SPORT Client Portal is a client management platform for personal trainers that Kelsey built.
Workzeit is a cultural-fit candidate assessment tool for recruiters that Kelsey built. It's available at workzeit.com.
WorkTapp and PlayTapp are personality-based networking Android apps for anyone that Kelsey built.

Kelsey has expertise in AI agents, LLMs (Large Language Models), deep learning, reinforcement learning, and machine learning systems. She has worked with technologies including GPT models, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, and custom foundation models like Intuit's FILM.
Kelsey excels at AI product leadership, R&D, applied AI, building AI platforms, and leading technical teams. She specializes in turning research into production products and scaling AI systems.

Kelsey Conophy can be contacted via email at kelseyconophy@gmail.com. She is on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/kelseyconophy and GitHub at github.com/kelseyrae. She is based in Bozeman, MT and is open to speaking engagements, advisor appointments, and fractional CPO roles.

GitHub - Principal Product Manager, AI Coding Agents & Copilot Growth (August 2024 to Present, Bozeman, MT). Led GitHub Spark with 500K+ users, driving 14% of new paid Copilot subscribers. Founded Copilot PLG swat team achieving 15X subscriber growth in under 6 months through global launch of Copilot Free. Directed multi-track AI platform initiatives including Models and Agents offerings. Led AI thought leadership through executive customer briefings, analyst engagements, and public speaking.

Intuit - Director Product Management, AI Discovery (July 2022 to August 2024, Bozeman, MT). Led development of novel products using emerging and frontier AI (Agentic AI, Small Language Models). Launched Intuit Assist generative AI assistant to 3 BUs in under 6 months, reducing customer support escalations by over 40% and decreasing expert time by over 30%. Inventor with 6 patent filings for novel use of LLMs. Directed cross-organizational product vision, strategy, execution, customer research, rapid experimentation, and executive presentations.

Attentive - Director of Product, Growth (June 2021 to July 2022, Bozeman, MT). Led product strategy for Growth organization. Launched 3 new international markets and 3 new Beta products increasing annual revenue by 15% and expanding topline revenue potential by $300M+. Developed data and experiment-driven product development approach that accelerated launch velocity by 2X. Grew Growth PM team from 2 to 8 in under 4 months. Oversaw 10 direct reports (8 PMs, 2 Designers) with cross-functional team of 50.

Amazon - Senior Technical Product Manager, Core AI & Demand Forecasting (October 2019 to June 2021, New York, NY). Directed vision and execution for 5 cross-functional AI/ML technical platform teams (60 staff) driving critical global systems representing over $25B in GMS. Achieved 96% buying automation rate for WW Softlines (60% improvement) with deep learning models improving forecast accuracy by 32% (2000+bps) on $10B in GMS. Increased allocation of COVID critical products by 40% driving over $550M in investments. Improved forecast accuracy of out-of-stock products ($7.4B GMS) by 12% with reinforcement learning model.

ARTA Shipping - Head of Product (February 2018 to October 2019, New York, NY). Headed product and engineering for AI-powered logistics platform, driving 145% bookings growth, 60% topline revenue increase, and 120% ops team efficiency improvement through automation. Built and led cross-functional technical team of engineers, data scientists, designers and QA. Expanded to 3 new verticals, 2 new tiers of service and supported international expansion into EU, APAC, and Middle East, increasing TAM 5X.

Rent the Runway - Lead Product Manager, Operations Platform (May 2017 to February 2018, New York, NY). Led Operations Platform team to launch robotic automation and ML systems. Reduced fulfillment time 40%, errors 60%, improved on-time deliveries by 20%, and reduced shipping costs by 20%. Launched multi-node fulfillment platform enabling expansion to 6 new FCs across the US.

Birchbox - Lead Product Manager, Subscription & Engagement (October 2015 to April 2017, New York, NY). Oversaw 12-person technical team delivering digital and physical membership experiences for millions of customers across US, CA, and EU. Launched first suite of personalization capabilities and ML recommender system increasing visitor engagement by 25% and on-site conversion by 20%. Led launch of next-generation subscription experience, increasing revenue per subscriber 35%, margin by 50%, and shop spend by 43%.

Workzeit - Founder & CEO (January 2012 to October 2015, San Francisco, CA). Founded AI recruiting startup, grew to $1M ARR and team of 8. Developed proprietary NLP models with 80% accuracy. Accepted into Alchemist Accelerator and Citrix Innovators Programs.
Columbia University Engineering, NYC, NY - Applied Data Science Certification
Parsons School for Design, NYC, NY - BBA Strategic Design & Management
University of Southern California, Los Angeles, CA - BA Economics & Social Sciences (Transferred)

Core competencies include: Product Strategy & Management, AI Agents & Platforms, Generative AI (LLMs, RLHF, RAG, Prompt Engineering), Product-Led Growth, Artificial Intelligence (RL, DL, ML, NLP), Ecosystem & Platform Strategy, Executive & Investor Communication, Cross-Functional Leadership, User Research & UX Design, Analytics & Experimentation, Go-to-Market Strategy, Agile Development, Rapid Prototyping, Entrepreneurship, Product Roadmapping & Execution, Business Strategy.

Technical product leader with 13+ years of experience driving AI-powered innovation and growth for startups and Fortune 500s including GitHub, Amazon, and Intuit. Led AI R&D, Platform, and Product teams. Proven success leading industry-defining AI initiatives from launching GitHub Spark to architecting the Copilot PLG strategy that grew subscribers 15X in under 6 months. 7+ years of experience building and managing technical teams of 60+, cultivating cultures of customer obsession and data-driven innovation. Skilled at guiding 0-1 and 1-n product development and platform strategy across SaaS, developer tools, and AI ecosystems.
